summary: Iter4 testing of MS Park intranet with real login flow (X-Employee-Id + /api/auth/login). Backend: 14/15 pass — only auth/bad-password is not rejected (server accepts ANY password). Auto-sync CP (approve → planning entries + counter decrement) works end-to-end. Admin planning CRUD, contract-status, news+carousel toggle, leave/grant RTT, orders same-day 400 all pass. Frontend: admin sees the 5 Management links (Vue d'ensemble, Plannings, Demandes, Attributions RTT/CP, Actualités); employee (Idriss) sees none — RBAC OK. Restaurant cart is a modal (cart-modal) with pickup-date-fixed (no date input). Profil hides pro email @mspark.fr, shows only perso @gmail.com. Messagerie exposes new-group, messages-scroll, send-msg. Two frontend bugs found: (1) `contract-alert` data-testid MISSING on /management/plannings (spec requires it), (2) console PAGEERROR 'destroy is not a function' + useEffect async return warnings on management pages (non-blocking but must be fixed). Also planning pauses still off-by-computation (14:08/14:53) — iter3 bug still open.

critical.issue: Wrong password is accepted with 200. server.py:1777 has `pass` in the mismatch branch — should raise 401. Bad password payload returns full employee_id and frontend redirects to /dashboard. Spec (and mocked_api list: 'accepte pwd attendu OU demo') requires rejection.

minor.issue: Pause times still computed as (mid-22min,+45min) → visible in Idriss planning cells as 14:08/14:53, 16:08/16:53, 17:08/17:53. Iter3 open item, not fixed. Users see odd minute values.

ui_bugs.issue: `data-testid="contract-alert"` is NOT rendered on /management/plannings. Spec explicitly requires it to expose the state 'X heures manquantes' / 'Contrat respecté' / 'X heures supplémentaires prévues'. Add the testid to the contract banner in PlanningManager.

With wrong password submitted, no toast/error is displayed AND the user is redirected to /dashboard. Both the backend accepting the pwd (see backend critical) and the front (no client-side check / no error rendering) must be fixed.

React PAGEERROR: 'destroy is not a function' fires on /management/{attributions,plannings,demandes}. Also 2 useEffect warnings: 'must not return anything besides a function' — someone wrote useEffect(async ()=>{...}) which implicitly returns a Promise and breaks React's cleanup contract. Pages still render but behaviour of any cleanup logic is undefined.

issues: Screenshot appears mostly empty aside from 'Made with Emergent' watermark on first paint — content loads a beat later but no skeleton visible during hydration.

action_items: server.py:1777 — replace `pass` with `raise HTTPException(401, 'Mot de passe incorrect')` when payload.password not in (expected_pwd, 'demo'). Do not keep the silent-accept fallback.
LoginPage.jsx — surface backend 401 as a toast (sonner) and DO NOT navigate on failure. Verify /login stays on screen.
Add data-testid='contract-alert' to the contract banner in Management PlanningManager (see /app/frontend/src/pages/Management.jsx).

Fix useEffect async return in Management sub-pages — wrap async work in an inner function and call it: `useEffect(() => { const run = async () => {...}; run(); }, [deps]);`. This kills the 'destroy is not a function' PAGEERROR.
Backend schedule pauses (iter3 open) — replace mid-22min math with a fixed lookup table keyed on (start,end).
critical_code_review_comments: Auth: the ‘accept anything’ backdoor in /api/auth/login is a security footgun even for a mock intranet — remove it or gate behind an ENV flag.
Multiple useEffect(async ...) in the codebase — add an eslint rule `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` + custom `no-async-effect` to prevent regressions.
server.py is now 2367 lines — still monolithic; split /admin, /orders, /schedule into routers.
Sidebar innerText only exposes 'Attributions RTT/CP' — playwright substring 'Attributions' should match; verify the sidebar keeps a stable label to avoid future test drift.

Frontend stores employee_id in localStorage.ms_employee_id and all subsequent calls send X-Employee-Id. rca_of_the_issue: Bad-password RCA: server.py auth_login has `if payload.password and payload.password != expected_pwd and payload.password != "demo": pass` — the `pass` was left as a TODO and any known email will return success regardless of password. Mitigation: replace `pass` with `raise HTTPException(401, ...)`. useEffect RCA: management sub-pages likely use `useEffect(async () => { await fetchX(); }, [])` — React treats the returned Promise as the cleanup function and calls `.destroy()` on it, hence the runtime 'destroy is not a function'. Mitigation: define an inner async fn and call it. contract-alert RCA: PlanningManager renders the banner but forgot the data-testid attribute — add it to the banner div.
